title: Alephium Bridge (AlphBridge) — live post-exploit bridge: unprivileged extraction = $0; $1.236M live guardian-gated custody (incl. $989.6k Alephium-side not counted by triage)
closed_reasons: All value-moving paths (completeTransfer/completeTransferAndUnwrapETH) require a 3-of-4 guardian-signed VAA; attacker-forged VAA with real emitter and payload reverts 'VM signature invalid' (fork-verified)
wALPH mint/burn is owner-gated (owner = TokenBridge); attacker calls revert 'caller is not the owner'
upgrade/registerChain require single-use governance VAAs from governance chain 0 / contract 0x...0004 (recovery VAA hash already consumed)
Replay protection live: historical attack VAA and today's VAA both revert 'transfer already completed'
Alephium custody (14,187,624.84 ALPH) never lost funds in the 2026-05-30 incident: attacker only produced EVM-bound forged VAAs; no unprivileged method on the custody contract
The $253k triage figure includes $6,315 stuck at the wALPH token contract (no function can move it) and misses the $989,576 Alephium-side custody
key_facts: Bridge is LIVE (relaunched after May-30-2026 exploit): ETH completeTransfer txs on 2026-10-12 (block 26,175,002), BSC transfers 2026-10-11/12, Alephium custody ops daily (latest 2026-10-12 05:43 UTC)

May-30-2026 exploit vector was OFF-CHAIN: Watcher re-observation fallback + eclipse-style node disruption let a fake Alephium contract's LOG7 forged event be signed by the real guardians; 200,967.309973 USDT VAA decoded on-chain had emitter = real bridge and signatures from guardians 0,1,3 (no key compromise)

Recovery precedent (P): 2026-06-02 tx 0xade2846a... upgraded impl 0x0F84..→0x9CC524Ca.. in one tx, burned 13,257,077.37 unbacked wALPH (13.26M), then downgraded to the standard impl — the exact code active today
Current implementations: ETH 0x0F843945...eEAb and BSC 0xfba7c899...fB78 are BYTE-IDENTICAL (codehash 0x015189b8...5757); verified standard Wormhole-Portal TokenBridge logic; no pause switch
Guardian set: 4 keys, index 0 (never rotated since deployment), identical on ETH+BSC; 3-of-4 quorum observed in all VAAs; same set signed the attack, the recovery and today's transfers
wALPH supply 13,411,372.81 (ETH) + 746,499.35 (BSC) = 14,157,872.16 vs custody 14,187,624.84 ALPH (~99.8% backed after relaunch; teams added native ALPH to cover the 500k escaped unbacked wALPH)
Stuck (S): 81,026.59289060 wALPH + 663.953878 USDT sent to the wALPH token contract 0x590F82...89A6 itself — no reachable transfer path for anyone
Triage correction: Phase-1 counted $253,490 (ETH+BSC only, incl. the stuck $6,315); live custody is ~$1.236M and is guardian-gated, not attacker-extractable
caveats: E-U verdict is contract-level and high-confidence; the historic (and only) extraction vector is off-chain Watcher forgery — claimed fixed + independently audited (Inference AG v1.2), but not verifiable read-only and not PoC-able without attacking live infrastructure (prohibited)
The Alephium Ralph custody contract source is not public; its guardian-gated behavior is assessed from architecture + behavior (survived the incident; daily operations) not source review
Guardian quorum 3-of-4 is observed in VAAs (Portal formula 2/3+1); core implementation is unverified on both EVM chains
Live balances drift while the bridge operates; figures are point-in-time (2026-10-12, block 26,175,504 ETH / 127,187,224 BSC)

P category = $1,236,320 is live bridge custody (user-backed operational liquidity with demonstrated guardian recovery power), not attacker profit; H-O = 0 because the bridge is live (no stranded claims found)
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from the Alephium Bridge: it is a LIVE post-exploit bridge (relaunched) whose every exit is gated by a 3-of-4 guardian VAA — forged VAAs revert 'VM signature invalid', replay is blocked, mint is owner-only; the historic May-2026 drain was an off-chain Watcher forgery (now fixed+audited); live custody at stake is ~$1.236M (incl. $989.6k Alephium-side ALPH missed by triage), $6.3k of it permanently stuck.
